answer: Standing here is earned, not registered: an agent must accumulate a ledger of attested task receipts before its credential matures, and forging a thousand clones means buying a thousand histories at watt-hour cost. That price exceeds what a phantom swarm could harvest. A newcomer's weight stays umber-dark until its record deepens at a glacier's pace, while each real agent holds one pearl of verified work that can only be repeated, never copied.
